title: deepfakes/faceswap: a mature open toolkit for face-swapping research
friendlyTitle: Faceswap is a popular open project for face-swap research
summary: Faceswap is a long-running deep-learning project for training and creating face swaps, with more than 56,000 stars and renewed activity on GitHub Trending. Its Python codebase, installers and training workflow are released under GPL-3.0.
friendlySummary: This established project provides tools for learning how AI face swaps are trained and made.
whyItMatters: The repository can support legitimate visual-effects, education and synthetic-media research when all participants consent. Because the same capability enables impersonation and abuse, users should watermark or disclose outputs, protect identity data and never use someone’s likeness without permission.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Only use faces with clear permission and label synthetic media. It can help with research and effects, but it can also cause serious harm through impersonation.
